title: Brute Force Attack
description: This attack consists of repeated failed login attempts from the same source IP within a short period of time. The pattern strongly indicates an automated password guessing attempt targeting root and admin accounts.
businessImpacts: Service disruption due to rate limit triggers & resource exhaustion

recommendedActions.text: Block Source IP (192.168.1.24) at ingress WAF
Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for target accounts
Review authentication logs for breached session tokens
Reset affected passwords and invalidate active JWTs

timeline.title: Security engineer notified
timeline.desc: Dispatched to SecOps primary on-call group

aiAnalysis.explanation: This attack attempts to guess passwords by repeatedly trying multiple combinations against the authentication gateway within a compressed timeframe.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: User accounts may be compromised, leading to unauthorized data exfiltration or lateral movement.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Immediately block the source IP at the network boundary. Force MFA re-validation and audit failed login audit trails.
futurePrevention: Implement adaptive rate limiting on /api/auth endpoints.
Monitor real-time authentication log telemetry via eBPF.

title: SQL Injection Attack
description: Interception of UNION SELECT payload attempting to dump admin credentials and bypass authentication routines on database endpoints.
businessImpacts: Database breach & confidential user data leakage
Compliance audit violation under HIPAA & SOC2 standards

recommendedActions.text: Quarantine source IP (185.220.101.5) at eBPF xdp layer
Enforce parameterized SQL prepared statements across API endpoints
Audit database user permissions and restrict table grants

timeline.title: Malicious SQL payload detected
timeline.desc: UNION SELECT signature matched in request body

timeline.title: WAF eBPF filter triggered
timeline.desc: Connection dropped prior to database arrival

aiAnalysis.explanation: An attacker sent a crafted HTTP request with SQL syntax to exploit string concatenation vulnerability in backend database query execution.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: Unrestricted database access could expose sensitive user PII and internal configuration secrets.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Immediately ensure all ORM queries use parameterized bindings. Verify input validation on all auth endpoints.
futurePrevention: Run daily automated SAST/DAST vulnerability scans.
Enforce least-privilege database user access roles.

title: DDoS SYN Flood
description: High-density TCP connection handshake flood attempting to exhaust kernel socket buffers and ingress load balancer bandwidth.
businessImpacts: Ingress network saturation and packet queue delay
Increased latency spikes for legitimate customer requests
Risk of node crash due to kernel memory exhaustion

recommendedActions.text: Enable eBPF SYN cookie challenge filter
Activate Anycast BGP rate limiter across edge PoPs
Blackhole offending subnet range at tier-1 provider

aiAnalysis.explanation: Distributed botnet nodes flooded ingress gateways with TCP SYN packets without responding to SYN-ACK, aiming to fill connection tables.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: Server unresponsiveness and temporary outage for external web traffic if unmitigated.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Maintain SYN cookie mode at kernel level. Monitor edge BGP telemetry for secondary attack waves.
futurePrevention: Configure hardware-accelerated XDP packet drop rules.
Distribute load across multi-region edge gateways.
Set lower TCP connection timeout limits.

title: Zero-Day RCE Probe
description: Anomalous HTTP POST request containing serialized object payload attempting remote code execution in container runtime environment.
businessImpacts: Container breakout and host infrastructure takeover
Arbitrary code execution with elevated root privileges
Lateral movement to internal Kubernetes cluster nodes

recommendedActions.text: Export memory forensic dump for malware analysis

timeline.title: Heap allocation anomaly flagged
timeline.desc: Unusual process spawn attempt in sandbox

aiAnalysis.explanation: An attacker attempted to pass a malicious payload that triggers arbitrary shell command execution during object deserialization.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: Full host system compromise, potential access to cloud service keys and customer databases.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Keep the pod isolated. Re-deploy patched image from secure CI/CD pipeline.
futurePrevention: Disable dynamic code execution in runtime containers.
Enforce read-only container root file systems.
Use eBPF runtime security agents like Falco or SentinelX.

title: XSS Cookie Exfiltration
description: Cross-site scripting payload injection attempting to read Document.cookie and exfiltrate session keys to external C2 server.
businessImpacts: User session hijacking and cookie theft
Account takeover for logged-in active users

recommendedActions.text: Enforce HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict flags on all session cookies

timeline.title: Marked as Resolved
timeline.desc: Session cookies secured with HttpOnly flag

aiAnalysis.explanation: Reflected cross-site scripting payload attempted to execute malicious JavaScript in user browsers to read auth cookies.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: Targeted account compromise if users visit un-sanitized pages.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Set HttpOnly on sensitive cookies so script cannot access them. Restrict CSP script sources.
futurePrevention: Enforce contextual output encoding in frontend templates.
Use automated AST vulnerability scanners in pull requests.
